snippet.title: Game of Planets - Teaser
snippet.description:
🌌  Welcome to **Game of Planets** – a fast-paced 2D strategy sandbox where you build, trade, conquer and survive in a living, procedurally generated galaxy.

► Steam Page & Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3815720/Game_of_Planets
► Join our Discord (alpha keys & dev talk): https://discord.gg/84h2cZ7U6Y
► Follow development on Twitter / X: https://twitter.com/IndieGamesStartup
► Studio site & newsletter: https://www.indiegamesstartup.com

👾  WHAT IS GAME OF PLANETS?
Game of Planets is an online 4X Grand Strategy MMORTS where every choice reverberates across a living galaxy of 1 600+ star systems and 10 000+ planets. Start with a single colony, then Explore, Expand, Exploit, Exterminate in real time against hundreds of other commanders.

🎯  WHY WISHLIST NOW?
Wishlisting boosts our visibility on Steam and helps us lock in more features for Early Access (targeting Nov 2025). It’s free, takes one click, and you’ll get notified the moment the public demo drops.  

💬  TALK TO THE DEVS
Swing by Discord, share feedback, or just watch the daily GIFs of exploding starbases. Early supporters often get **private beta keys** and vote on feature priorities.

🙌  THANK YOU
Hit 👍 if you dig planets, strategy or space drama, and drop a comment telling us which feature you want to see covered next!  

#GameOfPlanets #IndieGame #SpaceStrategy #Wishlist
